blocchi.nota: Initial state is always written as Original (magic=0x57, version=2, mode=0), so an applied ROM behaves like its base until wifi_server is set to something other than 0/1 in the public chunk at 0x023D8718. G3 (sgp_wfc_on_connect) re-reads wifi_server at every connection trigger: 2 or 3 selects that slot for GTS, Club, battle tower and the board, while Mystery Gift always uses slot 1. G1, the Overlay_Load epilogue at 0x020070A8, installs the two veneers into the RAM copy of ov000 and never touches an overlay image in ROM; it now calls +0x47C of the block (0x023DA47C), earlier +0x2B5, because the blob got shorter. The presence guard (magic 'W' at 0x023DA240) is what the Options page reads to enable its 'Server online' row. The veneer written to RAM is followed by cache maintenance (DC_FlushRange 0x020D2894, IC_InvalidateRange 0x020D28D0). Checks: the wifi read-back L1-L7 and the reserve checks T1-T5 pass on EN and IT, and 17 Unicorn tests cover the fallback rule; the two cases that need a live online trigger are covered by emulation only.
